rootCause: Not established; the initial script did not retain that subprocess stderr. Do not attribute this solely to bandwidth or SSH MaxStartups.
response: Stop original transfer; verify retained ranges against the remote encrypted file, then continue only missing ranges at six concurrent streams with per-range stderr retained.

secondAttempt.rootCause: Remote connection closure observed; underlying network or server cause unresolved.
secondAttempt.response: Verify every retained full and partial prefix against the server; transfer only missing suffixes in 1 MiB pieces, six streams, at most three bounded continuation attempts per suffix. Require the original whole-file hash.

thirdAttempt.response: Stop concurrent raw-PTY transfer. Preserve and freeze every absolute range, size and hash before changing transport.

transportInvestigation.attribution: Connection admission limiting and resets are observed, but individual failures are not all causally attributed. A successful exit code can accompany a short raw-PTY transfer. The probe supports testing one persistent non-PTY stream; it does not prove PTY is the sole cause.
transportInvestigation.boundedRecovery: One persistent non-PTY SSH connection, verify all retained range hashes remotely first, stream three missing intervals to a separate file, 900-second limit and no automatic retries; require the original whole archive length and SHA256 before decryption or Core cutover.
